evidence.quotation: Target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Defense Position.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current reference semantics in limited scope. Original MRD-133 printing date independently read on Konami as 2002-06-26. Historical printed wording remains pending; not presented as primary 2005 wording.

notes: Own open Main; hand or own Set. No discard cost. Target one opposing face-up Attack Position monster at activation; change to face-up Defense only after resolution. Does not change manual position-change markers or consume a summon. No face-down targets/FLIP, modifiers, immunity, replacements, general mixed Chain or negation.
